stem.text: A glass tube is closed at one end and has a loudspeaker at the other end.

stem.alt: Rectangular glass tube with a loudspeaker at its right-hand end; labelled glass tube and loudspeaker.

stem.text: A stationary wave is formed with a node at the closed end of the tube when the sound has frequency $f_{0}$. There are no other nodes.
The frequency of the sound is then slowly increased.
What is the frequency of the sound that produces the next stationary wave?
